text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
It looks like my new running style is 
gradually becoming more stable. I feel 
like I'll be able to run even more 
amazingly someday!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
However, there was something on my mind 
for a while... Zephyr-san seemed a bit 
troubled. When I worked up the courage to 
ask, she told me about it.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Zephyr-san looks up to someone and wants 
to do her best for their sake... but she 
says she's hit a massive wall.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"...I know what it feels like to want to 
do your best for someone else's sake... 
That's why in the next race, the Yasuda 
Kinen, I want my running to give everyone 
the courage to keep trying!"
